name: NocoBase Auth
description: Sync NocoBase users and roles to QwenPaw channel access control. NocoBase is the source of truth; local whitelist/blacklist is used as fallback when NocoBase is unreachable.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 将 NocoBase 的用户和角色同步到 QwenPaw 频道访问控制。NocoBase 为权威源；NocoBase 不可达时回退到本地白名单/黑名单。
description_i18n.en-US: Sync NocoBase users and roles to QwenPaw channel access control. NocoBase is the source of truth; local whitelist/blacklist is used as fallback when NocoBase is unreachable.
